bt: The jacaranda flowers are also riding the bus. Their tickets were bought by a small wind.
Half of the stars are behind the clouds. The small lights are doing their work.
The most beautiful blue (literally green-blue) sky in the whole country, but it feels as if you are in a fridge that has a display/show.
That one small light is a person who does winter well: a grass house, a fire, it is finished.
The sun does the outside admin. The heat was not part of the package.
